design.construction: New independent simulator routines (NOT R42A8A.example or batch), deterministic seeds fixed now, randomized order within class only; physical plausibility limited to synthetic hypotheses.
design.class_imbalance: Exactly 32 of each label family per environment per seed, label-blind candidate search shared for both labels.
design.candidate_method: Frozen R42A8A.blind_line_candidate() with same starts and slopes for all spectra; true injection coordinates for evaluation only.
design.noise_models: AR Gaussian low-level spectral correlation with power gradient/offset; independent student-t heavy tails with non-stationary gain and variable interference; no refitting on generated panels.

perturbations.method: Strict no-wrap shift of 128 channels; fill entering channels with per-epoch spectral median. Keep original candidate paths shifted, score paired frozen model on both. Restrict to original paths with all shifted bins within [16,111] for ±16 so no candidate leaves valid spectrum; do not re-detect and interpret as end-to-end invariance.
perturbations.model_zero_crossing_alert: If any tested shift changes sign across zero or exceeds absolute 0.2, mark abstain/keep; no suppression ever
perturbations.shadow_invariance_guard: Conservative unchanged-candidate veto abstains if any sign crossing OR max |score shift|>0.2, automatically KEEP every abstention. Research-only non-destructive diagnostic, not production.

analysis.primary: AUC frozen R42A7 shadow score vs AUC blind simple ridge-energy baseline per seed/environment; no threshold selection
analysis.weak: Weak-localization and weak-positive-versus-null AUC separately per environment and seed; sampled at 32 faint positives vs 128 nulls.
analysis.shift: Median, 95th percentile max abs score change, fraction with sign flips or over tolerance; paired weak subgroup abstention rate.
analysis.reproducibility: Repeat same seed twice, byte-for-byte hash of generated V, labels and original candidate paths; precommitted determinism test.
analysis.control: No historic R42A5/A6 audit group loading or calibration, frozen R42A7A ranker, no R42A7B real GBT test. Standardized metrics report all seed/environment combinations; no selecting the best seed.

predeclared_gates.potential_generalization: Every seed/environment frozen AUC>=0.70 AND frozen AUC >= simple ridge-energy AUC. Report FAIL if any domain misses.
predeclared_gates.weak_recovery: Each seed/environment faint-line blind trajectory correctly localized >= 24/32 (75%); this is independent of shadow score and NOT a full JANUS detector result.
predeclared_gates.score_shift: At most 1% sign crossings among all eligible paired shifts, p95 max abs delta <=0.20 across all tested candidates; FAIL otherwise.
predeclared_gates.safety: Always zero automatic suppression. Any failing property means HOLD, no posthoc tuning or production model adoption.
